single_cards.logic: Mulank = day of birth reduced to one digit (e.g. 28 -> 2+8=10 -> 1). Bhagyank = full date of birth reduced to one digit. Chaldean-Indian planet map used by Numeros Vision.

strengths: Comfortable leading and building from nothing
watch_outs: Can overrule others or resist advice
May lean on recognition from others
Can cool quickly on new ideas

single_cards.psychology: Core drive is to originate and be seen as the source of good ideas. Stress shows up as pride, impatience or going it alone.
single_cards.interpretation_draft: Mulank 1 is traditionally linked with initiative and independence. You tend to start things, lead from the front and trust your own judgement. Your growth edge is listening early and sharing credit.

validation.testable_statement: Reports a preference for starting projects rather than joining ones already running.
validation.method: Ask consenting users a short self-rating item; compare against a random-number baseline.
